title: Continuity State
description: Per-scene continuity ledger (production/scenes/<SC_ID>/continuity/scene-state.yaml and production/continuity/): established axes, character and prop state at scene time, lighting, and open issues. Updated after every scene; check-continuity.js validates shots against it.

axes.description: 180-degree lines established in the scene. Every shot's axis_id must resolve here.

established_in.description: First shot that establishes this axis.

subjects.description: Entities the line runs between (or along, for a movement axis).

character_states.description: State of each character at scene time, keyed by character ID.

wardrobe.description: Outfit ID worn in this scene (from the character's wardrobe.yaml; character namespace — LOOK_* is reserved for film looks).

wardrobe_state.description: Condition of the outfit at scene time.

props_held.description: Props the character is carrying; empty array means hands free.

position.description: Where the character is at scene time (mark or landmark, e.g. beside_bench).

last_seen_in.description: Most recent shot showing the character; null before first coverage.

prop_states.description: State of each tracked prop at scene time, keyed by prop ID.

location.description: Where the prop is (landmark, mark, or "held").

state.description: Physical condition (e.g. intact, open, rain-beaded, damaged).

holder.description: Character holding the prop, or null if unheld.

lighting.description: Established lighting condition every shot in the scene must match.

time_of_day.description: Story time of day; must agree with the scene definition.

open_issues.description: Unresolved continuity problems found during review.

severity.description: critical blocks generation/approval; note is informational.

shot.description: Shot where the issue appears; null for scene-wide issues.

last_validated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last continuity check over this scene.
